Who we are

About us

TS Solution (PT Hamparan Indah Rejeki) was established in 2013 as a transformation of its predecessor, SSM, which was founded in 2002 and grew to employ more than 3,000 people.

We are supported by a team of experts with extensive experience in Facility Services and Facility Management.

Our clients operate across a wide range of sectors, including:

  1. Industrial / Manufacturing (Factories) & Warehouse
  2. Residential & Service Apartments
  3. Office Buildings
  4. Public Facilities
  5. Hospitals
  6. Shopping Malls & Retail Centers
P

The “P Project”

In response to the growing challenges and the demand for superior client service, we have developed an ongoing innovation initiative inspired by Japanese work standards, known as the “P Project.” Through this program, we collaborate with several Japanese companies and send our local teams to undergo specialized training with experienced experts in Japan to ensure the successful adaptation and implementation of these high-performance work standards.
